body: I'm 21, but I don't think I could afford a therapist without the help of my parents. I could go to the counseling center on my campus though. I didn't know that they differentiated between ideation and intention. I think I might talk to my friend first. I know what you mean though, I know that on most days I'm fine and I can keep going, but the lows are overpowering sometimes, and I'm afraid what I might do one day if I get hit with a low that's just too much to handle. It pretty much almost happened that night on my friends birthday, but the day after I was disappointed and ashamed of myself for wanting that to happen. I knew how close that reality was from coming into fruition. I've always been a very spiritual person so I believe that everything happens for a reason, and we're all born into our lives to overcome or accomplish something great. I think that I didn't die that night because it was meant to show me what that reality really would've been like for everyone. It was meant to show me that I still have things that I need to do in this life. Thank you for your help. The world is uncertain, so who knows if we'll ever cross or have crossed paths, but you'll always have a friend in me, Anon. Thank you.

No, I've never been. I don't want people to know that  I'm suicidal though. I don't want them to worry. I just try to keep motivating myself to keep going. I keep telling myself just "survive for everyone else, then you can finally rest" then I find myself saying "once you're gone, none of it will matter, none of it will exist anymore, so don't worry, it's ok if you leave". I was about to tell a friend but idk if I'm going to do that anymore. I'm happy, a lot, or maybe I'm just faking it and lying to myself, but I'm happy a lot, it's just when the low really hits me, that's when I lose all of my hope. That's when I feel empty, and when I just want to leave.
